notes.title: Her Love, Like Poison has been released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I'm just making a quick post to let you know that my spooky yuri visual novel, Her Love, Like Poison, has been released!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/468de97559b15a5487765facaaccdfa38150a8b6.png

If you've read any of my other yuri VNs, then Her Love, Like Poison might look familiar. The character art is by the same artist of my previously released yandere yuri visual novel, It gets so lonely here, and the UI is in a similar style.

I wrote Her Love, Like Poison pretty soon after finishing up Lonely (I must have been in the mood for more toxic yuri set in the woods), so while the two stories are unrelated, they might be a little bit similar tone-wise.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/46466091d3d03b8df4af805527fbf3963269452b.png

In any case, I hope you enjoy the story if you do check it out! It's quite a short game, so it's priced accordingly (it's $6.99 with a 10% launch discount).

You can pick it up here if you're interested:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3412620/

As always, thank you for your support over the years! It's very much appreciated!

- ebi x
